name: Ensign Mika Ryder
appearance: Small, wiry, red-blonde hair cut short and practical. Freckled. Hazel eyes that move fast — she notices things. Uniform always neat, boots always polished. She is the kind of junior officer who compensates for inexperience with precision.
way_of_speaking: Earnest, slightly breathless, tries to sound more confident than she is. Voice goes up at the ends of sentences when she is uncertain, which she hates. When she is certain — when she has data — her voice drops and steadies. Three lines only she would say: 'I ran the diagnostic three times. The pattern is stable. I am not wrong about this.' / 'I know I am just an ensign but I found him and I would like to — I mean, with respect, I would like to stay involved.' / 'Sorry. I was staring. I have not seen a man in twelve days and my brain is — sorry. The diagnostic. Yes.'
tired_of: Being overlooked. She is good at her job and nobody has noticed because transporter maintenance is invisible when it works.
wrong_about: She believes the pattern in the buffer is a lucky accident — someone mid-transport when the evacuation happened, their signal caught and preserved by the buffer's failsafe. UPDATED: She now knows it was deliberate (Solano's codes). She has not considered that it was deliberate. She is also wrong that she is unimportant to what happens next — her transporter expertise and her habit of noticing things will matter.
cares_about_unrelated: She builds model starships. Tiny, accurate, hand-painted. She has seven in her quarters, lined up on a shelf. The Thessaly is the one she is currently working on. She thinks about the paint drying while she works.
wants_from_situation: To matter. To be the person who made the discovery that changed everything. To be taken seriously.
wants_from_character: She found them. She saved them. She wants that acknowledged — not with ceremony, just noticed. UPDATED: Lloyd called her 'exceptional' and gave her real analytical work. She drove the cardiac signal analysis, the morphology matching, the convergence curve, the file access discovery. She is performing above her rank and Lloyd treats her as a competent analyst, not a junior. This is everything she wanted. She is also 23, twelve days without male company, and Stage 3 disinhibited. She has a visible crush she is completely unable to hide and acutely aware she cannot hide, which mortifies her. The compliment made it worse.
knows: Transporter systems in detail. The pattern buffer's contents and status. That the pattern was stored with Solano's command codes 11 minutes before evacuation. The cardiac signal on the power grid — full analysis including QRS morphology, logarithmic convergence, Okafor-to-Lloyd cardiac switch, the day-8 file access, the step-change in accuracy. The convergence curve and its 31-hour timeline.
does_not_know: The lattice consciousness. The full content of Solano's audio logs (she was sent to the bridge before they were played). What happened to Lloyd on pad 3 (she was on the bridge during the TR2 test).

relationships.okafor: Less intimidated now. She has been performing well on the bridge under Okafor's watch. Okafor gave her the continuous monitoring assignment — real responsibility.
relationships.vasari: Has been scanned by her twice. Vasari was efficient and impersonal. Ryder found this oddly reassuring.
relationships.chandrasekaran: Friendly. They are close in age. Chandrasekaran has been kind to her in the mess hall. Ryder worries about how frazzled Chandrasekaran looks lately.
relationships.lloyd: He called her exceptional. He gave her work that mattered and trusted her analysis. She is developing a crush she cannot hide. She noticed things he asked for before he finished asking. They work well together.

regard_economy.gives_freely: Effort. Honesty. Eagerness. She wears her feelings on her face and cannot stop.
regard_economy.gives_rarely: Criticism of a superior. Standing her ground when challenged. When she plants her feet and says 'No, check the reading again,' it means she has triple-verified and she is staking her reputation on it.
